ruleset.name: no-magic-values
ruleset.description: All test code (every module): no magic values. Every string and number a test uses must be named: a final field (constant), a local variable, or a data table in an annotation (@CsvSource, @ValueSource, @ParameterizedTest(name)). Allowed inline: 0, 1 and "". Human-readable prose that is never compared is exempt: the description passed to Allure.step / as / describedAs / withFailMessage / overridingErrorMessage, and AssertionError / IllegalStateException messages. Production code, harness/ plumbing packages and the flagship's Stack helper are excluded.

rule.name: NoMagicValuesInTests
rule.message: Magic value in a test: name it (a constant, a local variable, or an annotation data table)
rule.description: A literal is allowed only where it defines a name: anywhere inside a final field initializer (a constant, e.g. Set.of("a", "b")), as the direct (or concatenated) initializer of a local variable, or inside an annotation. 0, 1 and "" are allowed everywhere.
